[[File:Mirkanite.jpg|thumb|Mirkanite mining]]
'''Mirkanite''' was one of the valuable [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] found in the [[Magma/Legends|lava]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Huge potential profits had spurred [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world, despite the safety risk.

It was also a substance commonly used in the construction of [[Superlaser/Legends|superlasers]]; the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tapped the planet for its resources during the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

[[Rianna Saren]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Mission to Mustafar (Rianna Saren)|destroyed]] the [[Mirkanite Mining Facility/Legends|Mirkanite Mining Facility]] on Mustafar during her mission to gather information on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] for the Rebellion.
